success.description: Historical approximate author-model estimate inferred across Sections4.2 and4.4, not a separately printed or validated eight-round rate. PDF9 / printed152 states approximately50% after the seven-round two-target-pass attack and remaining-key search. PDF10 / printed153 extends almost the same steps to eight rounds with unchanged data, exhaustive eighth-round key guessing and64 compared differences instead of32. The two target passes share equations8–11 and the same favorable parameter-reduction event, so their acquisition probabilities are not multiplied into0.25. This recovers the intended historical source-model estimate for this exact indexed output. The literal reduced-Equation9 table mismatch, later running-time objection and unverified output/completion accounting remain; no corrected or experimental recovery rate follows. Original estimated costs, settings and local event components are unchanged.

review.scope: Independent source-first and endpoint review accepts attribution of a historical cross-section author-model estimate only. Exact eight-round recovery at the original costs is not scientifically verified; equation, running-time and completion objections remain. No new completed full-paper or forward audit.
